content_sections.text: 6 Copies of filled online application form with photograph Valid photo ID issued by Govt of India Date of birth certificate Educational qualification mark sheets and passing certificates Proof of CGPA to percentage conversion norms Experience certificates Caste/Category certificate if applicable No Objection Certificate if working in Central/State/Autonomous Body

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for EIL Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Visit the career link on EIL website at http://www.engineersindia.com. Fill in the online application form with correct details. Upload scanned copy of recent passport size photograph and signature. Take 6 printouts of the submitted application form and affix colour photographs. Bring the printouts along with required documents while reporting for the interview. Apply on or before 2 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Cut-off date for educational qualification, experience and age limit is 30.09.2026 Candidates can apply for one position only Candidates shall make their own arrangements for travel and stay for the interview

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for EIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 2 November 2026. Applications opened on 19 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in EIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 109 vacancies: 19 Associate Engineer Grade II, 47 Associate Engineer Gr. III, 36 Associate Engineer Gr. IV, 7 Associate Officer Gr II.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for EIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 2 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Associate Engineer Grade II: maximum 37 years; Associate Engineer Gr. III: maximum 41 years; Associate Engineer Gr. IV: maximum 45 years; Associate Officer Gr II: maximum 37 years. Relaxation: SC/ST 5, OBC 3, PwD-General/EWS 10, PwD-OBC 13, PwD-SC/ST 15.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 72000 - 80000 for Associate Engineer Grade II, Rs. 86400 - 96000 for Associate Engineer Gr. III, Rs. 100800 - 112000 for Associate Engineer Gr. IV, Rs. 72000 - 80000 for Associate Officer Gr II.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.Tech/B.E., B.Sc, Diploma, Graduate, depending on the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening of applications and certificates. Personal Interview at EIL Gurugram, Mumbai, Chennai or Kolkata Office. Screening of applications on the day of interview. Personal Interview for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Hiring is purely on fixed term basis initially for 2 years, extendable for 1 year based on performance, for a maximum period of 3 years.

faq.question: Q10. Which places are covered by EIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Nigeria, Ethiopia, India.
